name: Encyclopædia Britannica
summary: Britannica's short entry is silent on 29 of the 36 points, gives the same answer as one group of versions on 6 and a different answer on 1. It agrees with English, Arabic and Russian that Iranians carried out the 1953 coup with US and UK support, with Persian, Arabic and Spanish on lymphatic cancer, and with most versions on 16 January 1979 and the route of his exile; on why he left Iran it gives no reason beyond that he 'fled the Iranian Revolution'. Its own entry on Mosaddegh puts the same coup differently, as 'orchestrated by' the United States and the United Kingdom.
